lead: A new item-producing function in `nvs-lsp`'s completion fails a test that names no arm you touched.
body: `every_completion_source_names_a_compiler_table` reads that module's own source and compares every function returning a `CompletionItem` against the `SOURCED` table beside it, so an arm added without a row fails in `crates/nvs-lsp/tests/completion.rs` rather than where it was written. Add the row — the function's name, and a needle from its body naming the compiler table it reads — and widen the array's declared length.
